output.reason: The linked PR [ev-043428f564d1] names the subject: the PACKAGE_RUNTIME setting. It says the existing value (PACKAGE_RUNTIME=External) "will still work". It adds a new value, PACKAGE_RUNTIME=Independent, that is combined with a new PACKAGE_FUNCTION_RUNTIME setting, and providers still run as Deployments by default. So this is an additive change, and an operator who does nothing keeps the current behaviour. [ev-93b2baca7cff] adds two side effects that apply to External runtimes: the Revision Parent no longer sets the TLS Server/Client Secret, and Crossplane now reads the TLS secret names from the Revision status. That gives enough to write the assertion, but [ev-93b2baca7cff] is cut off mid-sentence, and no excerpt shows an exact provider-specific setting name.
